thread:
sam-ml: Heads-up: community-submitted checkpoint 'Argus-8B-Lite' landed in our intake bucket. Want to run 4-bit quant experiments and potentially offer on Hosted + Dedicated. Can we redistribute quantized weights to Dedicated customers?
maria-legal: Need to see the upstream license. Quick flag: if it says redistribution only in source form, shipping pre-quantized binaries to customers will be blocked. Also watch for a 'no sublicensing' clause.
danielle-research: Pasted license summary from repo: 'Commercial use allowed. Redistribution: allowed only in source form. Derivatives allowed with attribution. No sublicensing.' (not verbatim).
alex-platform: Practically: Dedicated runs ship container images with weights baked in -> that's binary redistribution. Hosted API (we run weights inside our infra, no downloads) is typically fine.
sam-ml: If we do PTQ in our infra and keep qweights private for only inference (no image exports), is that redistribution?
maria-legal: Creating a derived binary and then giving it to customers = redistribution. If they can't download or get an image, Hosted API serving the model is okay.
danielle-research: Quick eval notes: baseline MMLU 87.2 -> PTQ 4-bit 85.6; small QAT run recovered to 86.9. Latency improvement ~30% on our runtime.
sam-ml: Ops question: product wants a low-cost quantized option for Dedicated customers (they'd get an image). If upstream refuses redistribution of binary qweights, can we offer a networked-only option?
maria-legal: Yes. If redistribution denied, offer Dedicated customers a 'hosted-local' mode: dedicated VMs/containers that access our hosted model over internal network (no weight export). But we must make this explicit in contracts.
alex-platform: If we get permission, we still need exact terms: allowed distribution methods (OCI registry push vs image tarball), required included files (LICENSE, attribution text), and any extra notices in product UI.
maria-legal: Actionable ask: Sam, get a written grant from Argus.ai with exact wording permitting redistribution of derived/quantized binaries to Redwood's customers. Request the precise attribution text they want included. Save email thread in model intake.
sam-ml: Drafted and sent: 'Hi Argus team — Redwood is evaluating Argus-8B-Lite. Please confirm whether we may redistribute derived quantized model binaries to Redwoods paying customers under our customer agreements. If yes, please provide the exact attribution text and any redistribution constraints.' CCing @maria-legal.
ci-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-internal/models/argus-8b-lite/2026-03-20/argus-8b-lite.tar.gz :thumbsup:
danielle-research: Re: internal experiments, can continue running PTQ/QAT inside our infra regardless of redistribution answer. We'll attach the eval report to Model Intake.
maria-legal: Compliance checklist to close before redistribution: 1) upstream license text + written redistribution grant; 2) provenance/training-data summary; 3) eval report for quantized variants (regression numbers + CI); 4) attribution text for UI and LICENSE file to include in any distributed image; 5) add distribution method to Dedicated onboarding doc.
alex-platform: Ops items if allowed: automate adding LICENSE & attribution into images, document whether we provide OCI registry access or tarball, and add a flag in Dedicated provisioning to choose 'quantized-image' vs 'network-proxy-only'.
sam-ml: If upstream denies binary redistribution, plan B: host both FP and quantized variants in Redwood-hosted infra; for Dedicated, only expose through an API proxy or offer unquantized source-only images if they build locally.
maria-legal: Also consider adding a simple UI credit on model details page: 'Argus-8B-Lite — © Argus.ai — Licensed under Custom Research+Redistribution v1.0 (see LICENSE)'. If Argus requests different wording, we must use their exact text.
danielle-research: Noting tradeoffs: PTQ saves cost but has small quality hit; QAT looks promising but needs longer runs. Will include QA & regression thresholds in intake.
sam-ml: Next steps: wait for Argus reply; ops on hold for Dedicated image creation; research continues internally. I'll paste upstream response here when it arrives.
maria-legal: Thanks. If upstream grants redistribution, we'll need a short internal approval sign-off before anything ships.
alex-platform: Acknowledged; will prepare gating checklist for image build.
ci-bot: model intake form updated: /intake/models/argus-8b-lite (attachments: license.txt, eval-report.pdf)
